value.timingSummary: Approx. 90 days from accepted processing (CIU guideline)

items.label: Published processing guideline
items.text: The CIU’s FAQ describes approximately 90 days from notification that an application is accepted for processing to grant of citizenship. It acknowledges possible delays. This is not measured current performance or a passport-delivery promise.

items.label: Official fiscal-year activity
items.text: The 2024/25 annual report records 2,957 applications received and 2,633 processed: 2,278 grants and 355 denials. Decisions need not concern files received in the same period.

evidence.locator: Licensed-agent submission and an approximately 90-day guideline from notification of acceptance for processing to citizenship grant; exceptional delays are acknowledged.
